newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 29.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordanians and Palestinians agree on Egyptian president's suggestion of small Arab summit.
- Saudi Arabia gold market worth $3 billion a year.
- Saudi supermarket chain Azizia Panda posts 15 million riyals net profit in the first quarter of 1997.
- Moroccan Airlines studies buying two Airbus jets.
- Riyadh governor holds talks with French officials on peace process in the Middle East.
- Four Kuwaiti firms to open a recreation company with a capital of $33 million.
